close_reason: Deleted AppliedStep output aggregation; tests now observe the scheduler claim ledger, with docs and full gates updated.
description:
## Goal

Delete `AppliedStep.outputs` and the production work performed solely to populate it.

## Evidence

`Scheduler::complete` currently allocates an `OrderedSet` and clones every reported output into it on every completion. Production telemetry does not serialize or consume the field. The only reader is `drive_test::OutputCapture`. The representative 00420 trace contains 2,381 applied completions, so this test affordance is paid on the hot path thousands of times.

## Strategy and proof

1. Pin the existing output-observation tests against the authoritative standing claims in `World`.
2. Move `OutputCapture` to that test-only observation boundary.
3. Delete `AppliedStep.outputs`, its aggregation, and documentation claiming the completion owns an output-key set.
4. Prove identical changed facts, wakes, movements, blocked uses, causal traces, semantic answers, and artifacts.
5. Run focused scheduler/drive tests, the full library suite, fixture matrix, formatting, and clippy with warnings denied.

Do not add a replacement production carrier. The surviving authority is the scheduler claim ledger.
title: Stop rebuilding test-only output sets on every scheduler completion
